title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one input yields separately named condensate and residue
summary: Look for a complete dated technical instruction that explicitly names one starting material, an apparatus operation, a collected output and a distinct remainder. Freeze the source's ownership and two output directions before any manuscript reading. A candidate complete reading on an already admitted pharmaceutical or apparatus record must account for both outputs under one input; a one-product preparation or a simple transfer should remain a rival. Source availability, target topology and word binding are unknown. This is an unselected proposal, not an executed experiment or a meaning claim.

design.mechanism: a source-owned operation splits one retained input into two different named outputs
design.unit: one complete historical instruction and one complete already admitted candidate record
design.contrast: two-output material split versus single-output preparation or location transfer
design.prediction: a frozen whole reading preserves common input ownership and assigns distinct output roles to both products; absent independent target binding yields missing capacity
